TCS CEO Discusses Industrial Demand and AI's Impact on IT

TCS Managing Director and CEO Krithivasan stated that the company anticipates a recovery in industrial demand. He also noted that traditional IT growth is expected to slow down as Artificial Intelligence becomes more prominent in the sector.
